AI-Powered Pilot Fatigue Monitoring System

A system that watches for pilot fatigue in real time — combining a camera-based facial scan with manual duty/sleep inputs — and automatically checks every duty period against ICAO's rest-and-duty rules, flagging violations before they become safety incidents.

FlutterReact + ViteNode.js / ExpressPython FastAPIMediaPipeKeras MLPMongoDB Atlas
Mobile app
Admin dashboard
  • Detection: a 60/40 weighted score combining live eye-aspect-ratio tracking with manual sleep, duty, and caffeine inputs.
  • Compliance: automated checks against ICAO's 13-hour max duty and 8-hour min rest rules, with real-time violation flags.
  • Process: six Agile sprints, full SDLC documentation (SRS, SDS, STD, UAT).

REAL-TIME SOFTWARE ENGINEERING · GROUP PROJECT (TEAM OF 4) SHIPPED

SpeedTrials2D — Real-Time Autonomous Driving Simulation

My role: perception module — token, police car, and chasing-car detection

A real-time driving controller for a Unity-based simulator, connected over TCP sockets. A custom concurrent task scheduler runs camera capture, perception, and control as separate priority-scheduled threads, feeding a priority-based finite state machine (low light → chasing evasion → police response → lane navigation → cruise) that governs steering and speed.

PythonOpenCVMultithreadingSocket programmingUnity (simulator)
Live simulation · 4-camera view
  • Perception (my contribution): HSV colour-masking and contour analysis to classify collectible/hazard tokens, and detect a police car and a pursuing car in real time.
  • Concurrency: priority-scheduled threads for camera reads, processing, and control commands, running on fixed periods.
  • Team build: the finite state machine, steering, and lane logic were built by teammates — this was a genuine group effort.
